hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/block-raw-dvc-checkout.py"; if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then echo "block-raw-dvc-checkout: $f が無いので dvc checkout を確かめていない（CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR を確かめる）" >&2; exit 1; fi; input=$(cat); case $input in *checkout*) printf %s "$input" | python3 "$f"; exit $?;; esac; exit 0
